_meta.review_notes: Fixture tests/fixtures/05_sort_external_merge.txt is a hand-authored EXPLAIN ANALYZE output: Sort -> Seq Scan on events with estimated rows=1000, Sort Method 'external merge  Disk: 48kB', Sort Key 'created_at'. MEM-001 fires on the Sort node because is_sort_node(Sort)=true and 'external merge' contains 'external'. extract_disk_size('external merge  Disk: 48kB') returns '48kB'. detail template 'Sort Method: %{value}' becomes 'Sort Method: external merge  Disk: 48kB'; with Sort Key appended: ', Sort Key: created_at'. suggestion template with disk='48kB' produces 'SET work_mem to a higher value; sort spilled to disk (48kB), consider creating an index on the sort key to eliminate sorting'. SCAN-001 does NOT fire (1000 rows < 10000 threshold, and Sort is in the legitimate-ancestor allowlist). SCAN-004 does NOT fire (no Filter property). SORT-003 does NOT fire (single Sort, no Sort descendant). GEN-001 does NOT fire (depth=2 <= threshold 10). MEM-004 does NOT fire (no Peak Memory summary line or Memory Usage property). source=supplemental because no ogagila v3 query produces an external-merge Sort as the pre-recorded EXPLAIN material; all four MEM-001-targeted queries (Q24-Q27) use top-N heapsort with LIMIT and never spill to disk.

anti_findings.reason: Seq Scan on events has estimated rows=1000 (< large_table_rows default 10000). Additionally, Sort is in the legitimate full-scan ancestor allowlist (scan_rules.rs:90).
SCAN-004 requires a Filter property on the scan node. The Seq Scan in fixture 05 has no Filter.
SORT-003 fires when a Sort node has a Sort descendant. Fixture 05 has exactly one Sort node, no children Sorts.
GEN-001 (PlanTooDeep) fires when plan depth exceeds max_plan_depth (default 10). Fixture 05 depth = 2 (Sort -> Seq Scan).
